answer.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification test for price-sensitive SMBs to accelerate time-to-value and reinforce product value without matching the competitor’s unsustainable discount. Shortened onboarding produced +13% completion, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%; signup simplification also produced durable SMB activation gains. Do not broadly deploy promotional pricing: although it lifted signup by 31% and qualified revenue by 18%, retention fell 12%, indicating substantial renewal and downstream-revenue risk. The discount evidence warrants later verification because the durable memory summary conflicts with the recovered source record.
